name: prompt-audit
description: Audit one prompt's effectiveness for a specific target coding model — token efficiency, goal clarity, confusion/hallucination triggers, capability limiting, and more. Evidence-cited findings tables, an honest verdict, prioritized refinement advice, and an optional approval-gated rewrite. Asks instead of guessing whenever intent is unclear.

defaultPrompt: Run /prompt-audit:audit-prompt (Claude Code) or $prompt-audit (Codex), then paste the prompt you want audited or give its file path.
